measurement_validation.reviewer_requirement: Genuine second human, no prior AI labels; separate Stage A semantic and Stage B boundary decisions. No such reviewer is claimed available.
measurement_validation.agreement: Categorical confusion/raw agreement; nominal kappa only if estimable; weighted ordinal kappa; boundary exact/token-span agreement and abstention; speaker-cluster sensitivity and enriched-stratum disclosure.

empirical_replication.allocation: Balanced incomplete blocks: two distinct task families per speaker, one current and one historical, rotate family/date pairing across 12 blocks. 48 and 96 speakers permit four/eight replications per block. All six R/T/control cells paired within every case.
empirical_replication.new_materials: Fresh identities, independently assigned values and unseen wording templates; no inspected P1b/P1c case is held out.
empirical_replication.primary_candidates: Prospective six-test family: temporal Incorrect incidence and task success across R/T/RxT; not a change to current hierarchy. Must be approved before generation.
empirical_replication.selection: Information and precision, never desired effect direction. No expansion or optional stopping based on significance.
empirical_replication.controls: Keep identical sufficient ledger; test actual orthogonality and answer-competition separation. Independently validate semantic controls and actual GGUF full prompt tokenization.
empirical_replication.model_policy: Retain pinned Base as reference; any Instruct arm uses separately frozen official template and identity. Configuration comparison is not pure post-training.

reproducibility: Freeze protocol, samples, prompts, token arrays, labels/policy, analysis, seeds and authorizations before independent generation; no test-set tuning.
